messages:
maya: Quick pre-launch sync for v1.24. EU change window 2026-03-22 00:30 UTC. Need final RN copy, ops pin, and deploy-bot schedule. Who picks up pin+monitor?

sam: Ill own rollback criteria and update runbook. tagging @lee for ops lead.

lee: I can take ops. Confirm pins: runtime=0.9.3 and EU default model redwood-neo-1.1-q8? Also note quant toggle applied for EU only.

maya: That's right. RN should mention quant toggle (non-breaking) and add a "What to watch" bullet about KV cache warmup (first 5-10m).

natalie: Docs preview: https://redwood.internal.preview/1.24/embed-snippet. Suggest headline: "Faster inference, lower cost — EU rollout". I'll shorten staff blast.

maya: Draft staff blast: "Heads-up: v1.24 EU rollout 22 Mar 00:30 UTC. Runtime 0.9.3. Model pin: redwood-neo-1.1-q8 (EU only). Brief cache warmup possible. Oncall: lee, sam. Full notes: <doc>."

sam: Rollback thresholds: p99 > 250ms sustained 10m OR error_rate > 1% for 5m -> rollback to runtime-0.9.2. Manual rollback if eval shows quality regression. I'll add to runbook.

lee: Pushing route policy to pin model default for EU and set canary 10/90 now.

ops: Route and canary policy applied. cfg id cfg-eu-20260322-17. Dashboard: https://grafana.internal/d/aeu/eu-release-1-24. Adding alerts.

deploy-bot: Deploybot: scheduled -> prod | env=eu-prod | version=runtime-0.9.3 | start=2026-03-22T00:30:00Z | canary=10% | auto-rollforward=false | notify=#eng-releases :robot_face:

deploy-bot: Deploybot: canary started 2026-03-22T00:30:30Z — canary=10%. Metrics: p95=120ms p99=190ms error_rate=0.08%.

lee: Canary looks good so far. I'll watch 30m and 1h checkpoints.

maya: Posting staff blast at 00:35 UTC. Natalie queued the channel. Leaving thread open for alerts.

ops: Alerting rule added (2m digest to #eng-releases + pager to oncall if thresholds hit).

deploy-bot: Status update 2026-03-22T00:58:30Z — canary steady, no anomalies detected :white_check_mark:
